scope.operation: insert absent curated draft records only

passingChecks: Only zero args or exact single --write accepted
Exactly three candidate/stage pairs and selected figure keys required
Candidate status draft and empty saved review required
Completion document pins candidate/stage bytes and complete canonical text
Strict candidate parser and mechanical draft/publication simulation used without persisting simulated reviews
700-950 words, adult18-100 episode, sentence rhythm, dark<=180, real reading chunk bounds and replay checked
Only absent rows inserted using SDK ignoreDuplicates; installed SDK maps this to resolution=ignore-duplicates
Foreign-key order figures then stages then story_specs
Stage status omitted with defaultToNull=false; installed SDK requests missing=default, current migrations own default draft
Exact same target draft rows permitted on retry; conflicting or published targets rejected before writes
Whole selected business fields and unrelated catalog content compared after insert

blockingFindings.observed: created_at, published_at and retired_at are absent from the snapshot; source-derived mock mutation to old created_at is not detected and success receipt is emitted.
blockingFindings.repair: Select all three lifecycle columns. Project business fields when comparing desired target documents, while comparing every complete preexisting row including lifecycle values. Require fresh target created_at and null published_at/retired_at.

blockingFindings.observed: The same baseline filename is truncated on every --write retry. Source-derived two-run mock proves first baseline is replaced by the snapshot containing newly inserted drafts; final receipt has beforeHashes but no immutable baseline file/content pin.
blockingFindings.repair: Write a distinct exclusive baseline per attempt before any insert, preserve earlier baseline receipts, and bind successful receipt to the exact baseline filename/content SHA-256. Use exclusive creation so timestamp collisions fail before writes rather than overwrite.

executionBoundaries.partialFailureRecovery: Existing exact drafts may be retried; partial insert errors do not trigger status updates, deletes or automatic rollback.
executionBoundaries.concurrencyQualification: Full unrelated-content comparisons detect concurrent changes after this attempt, but do not provide a cross-table transaction or prevent an independent operator from publishing/editing during the three writes. Root is the sole authorized curated DB writer for this batch.
executionBoundaries.liveInvocationPrecondition: Stable independently cross-reviewed candidate/stage hashes copied by root, repaired helper rechecked, and no concurrent editorial writer.

qualification: Read-only code audit plus exact-source-derived synthetic in-memory write-path probes. This does not verify evolving prose, live production schema, actual Supabase responses, matching quality or publication approval. Root remains sole live database writer.
